@graph.name: ClinVar VCV XML
@graph.description: The Cascade Bridge Adapter for ClinVar VCV XML: the package of data a Cascade Bridge runs to turn NCBI ClinVar variation records into Cascade RDF, the pilot adapter. Import-only. Phase 1 (0.2.0) has no mapping and nothing that executes. This crate is the adapter's manifest: a Bridge reads the root entity first, for the format id (identifier, the same string cascade-cli accepts for --from, from src/lib/clinvar-converter/registry-entry.ts), the source schema, the two envelopes, the unit, the detect rule, the profile the Bridge must offer, the vocabulary pin and the test manifest; the data entities carry provenance for every committed fixture, schema and document and for every remote dataset the adapter references. Committed inputs carry a sha256 computed locally over the committed bytes. Remote datasets carry the md5 NCBI publishes in the .md5 file beside each release. Four inputs and their expected graphs and findings are copied byte for byte from the conformance repository; their fetch date and method were not recorded when they were captured, and each entry says so. Dates and sizes for remote files were read from ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov on 2026-09-06. The phase 2 mapping (mainEntity, Workflow RO-Crate), tables (bridge:table) and extension vocabulary (bridge:extensionVocabulary) are absent until the files exist; nothing for the export direction is declared, because ClinVar is import-only.

@graph.name: efetch
@graph.description: E-utilities efetch (db=clinvar, rettype=vcv). All five committed inputs. NCBI's XSD does not declare this root; the wrapper schema named as the document schema adds it, so a whole efetch response validates.

@graph.name: release
@graph.description: The monthly and weekly release files, ClinVarVCVRelease_*.xml.gz. Declared by NCBI's XSD directly, so no document schema beyond the source schema is needed. The root element is still ClinVarVariationRelease although the file name family changed to ClinVarVCVRelease in August 2025; docs/format.md, "The two envelopes".

@graph.name: xslt-3
@graph.description: The optional Bridge profile under which a Bridge runs an adapter's XSLT 3 mapping. Required here because the phase 2 mapping is XSLT 3, one module per record class. Declared in the Cascade Bridge Specification's vocabulary, vocab/bridge.ttl in cascade-bridge-spec at the commit bridge:specPin names.

@graph.name: Cascade Bridge Adapter profile
@graph.description: The RO-Crate 1.2 Profile Crate a conforming adapter package names in conformsTo: the machine-checkable claim that this crate is an adapter package, whose constraints resource is the SHACL shapes in cascade-bridge-spec. The IRI does not dereference yet, which that repository's README records; the Profile Crate describing it is profile/ro-crate-metadata.json there, and bridge:specPin says at which commit.

@graph.name: cascade-bridge-spec at 0af0fc9
@graph.description: The revision of the Cascade Bridge Specification this adapter is written against: the merge commit of cascade-bridge-spec PR #7, released as v0.2.0, which removed that repository's catalogue of adapters and published its lint as a reusable action. The tag v0.2.0 points at this SHA and keeps it reachable if the branch is later reset or rebased, which is why an untagged commit is not pinned (docs/alignment.md there). The same revision is named twice on purpose: here for the reader, and in .github/workflows/validate.yml as the ref the lint is called at, for the machine; the lint fails the run if the two disagree, and they move together in the same pull request. This is also the revision whose vocab/bridge.ttl and shapes/bridge.shapes.ttl replaced this adapter's own copies under schema/manifest/, which were the seed of them. Read on 2026-09-06. A web-based data entity, referenced and not committed, the way the vocabulary pin is: the RO-Crate 1.2 validator reads every SoftwareSourceCode as a script that must be a File in hasPart.

@graph.name: spec at e77ba5e
@graph.description: The spec revision the adapter's vocabularies are pinned to: the same pin conformance/scripts/SPEC_PIN carries, the merge commit of jayostis/spec PR #53 (core v3.13, health v2.9, clinical v1.20, coverage v1.9, checkup v3.5, pots v1.5). The commit is on the fork, jayostis/spec, and not yet on the-cascade-protocol/spec: it is not an ancestor of the org's main, so naming the org would point at a revision the org does not hold. Six tags (vocab/core-v3.13, vocab/health-v2.9, vocab/clinical-v1.20, vocab/coverage-v1.9, vocab/checkup-v3.5, vocab/pots-v1.5) point at this SHA and keep it reachable if the fork's main is reset or rebased; the pin moves to the org in the same commit that re-pins to an org SHA, once the vocabulary lands there. Read from conformance/scripts/SPEC_PIN on 2026-09-06. A web-based data entity, referenced and not committed, the way the release files are: the RO-Crate 1.2 validator reads every SoftwareSourceCode as a script that must be a File in hasPart.

@graph.name: Cascade genomics vocabulary
@graph.description: One of the two Cascade vocabularies the adapter writes. Pre-stable: at the pin, ontologies/genomics/v1-draft/genomics.ttl carries owl:versionInfo "1.0-draft.0.6"; the version recorded here is the draft label. Its terms go through spec's own process; none is minted in this adapter.

@graph.name: Cascade core vocabulary
@graph.description: One of the two Cascade vocabularies the adapter writes. At the pin, ontologies/core/v1/core.ttl carries owl:versionInfo "3.13", the version spec's VOCAB_VERSIONS records. The stamp predicates the test manifest ignores when comparing (cascade:dataProvenance, cascade:schemaVersion) are its terms.

@graph.name: ClinVar VCV XSD, version 2.6, pinned copy
@graph.description: NCBI's schema pinned byte for byte: the source schema every VariationArchive unit is validated against, and the schema schema/ClinVarResult-Set.xsd includes. Identical to the file at the isBasedOn URL, whose entity carries NCBI's date and the note on 2.5: md5 is NCBI's sibling .md5 file, sha256 is computed locally over the committed bytes. Never edited; to change it, replace it from its source and update contentSize, sha256 and md5 in the same commit. docs/format.md says why 2.6 and not 2.5 is pinned.

@graph.name: efetch envelope wrapper schema
@graph.description: Includes NCBI's ClinVar_VCV_2.6.xsd unchanged and declares the one document root NCBI's schema leaves undeclared, ClinVarResult-Set, so a whole efetch response validates and not only the records inside it. The document schema of the efetch envelope (#envelope-efetch); .vscode/settings.json associates fixtures/in/*.xml with it.

@graph.name: Test manifest
@graph.description: The cases a Bridge's harness executes and how each is judged: a W3C-style test manifest (mf: test-manifest vocabulary) whose entries are typed with the bridge: vocabulary and constrained by the SHACL shapes, both of them in the Cascade Bridge Specification at the commit bridge:specPin names (vocab/bridge.ttl and shapes/bridge.shapes.ttl in cascade-bridge-spec). This adapter carried copies of the two until 0.2.0; they were the seed of that repository, and a second statement of a contract is one that can disagree with it. Every input, expected graph, findings file, dataset and envelope this manifest names is described in this crate, by the same IRI, and it names this crate's root entity as its adapter, so the manifest and this crate load as one graph.

@graph.name: ClinVar VCV monthly release, 2026-09
@graph.description: Every VariationArchive in ClinVar at ReleaseDate 2026-08-29, in the ClinVarVariationRelease envelope (#envelope-release), declaring xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation http://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/xsd_public/ClinVar_VCV_2.6.xsd (read from the first 256 KB of the file on 2026-09-06). md5 is NCBI's, from the sibling .md5 file. Size and date are from the HTTPS headers (Last-Modified 2026-09-03T04:07:26Z). Referenced by its dated name; ClinVarVCVRelease_00-latest.xml.gz is a symlink to it and is never the reference. Monthly releases are generated on the first Thursday of the month. Not committed. No weekly release is listed: on 2026-09-06 the weekly symlink under weekly_release/ resolved to this file, and a Dataset entity with no content of its own is not something a Bridge can run; a dated weekly is added here, with its contentUrl, md5, contentSize, version and datePublished, when one exists (docs/format.md, "Releases").

@graph.name: ClinVar VCV XSD, version 2.6
@graph.description: NCBI's published schema, pinned byte for byte as schema/ClinVar_VCV_2.6.xsd. Its version attribute reads "2.6; February 26, 2026"; dateModified is the HTTPS Last-Modified. md5 is NCBI's sibling .md5 file, checked against the download; sha256 is computed locally. ClinVar_VCV.xsd and ClinVar_VCV_weekly.xsd on the same site publish the same md5. It supersedes 2.5 (md5 169e958e2f06c6a3ba8a96aae3a949a9, "2.5; August 6, 2025"); the whole difference is one optional derived_by attribute, enumerated to NCBI, on SetElementSetType. The 2026-09 monthly release declares 2.6, which is why 2.6 and not 2.5 is pinned.
